name: fieldnotes-reference-a

kokoro.note: Reference A's own engine and voice (am_adam, speed 1.05). Timbre and pitch are Kokoro's; the ONNX path adds sentence_pause_s between sentences (calibrated so comma-heavy and sentence-heavy scripts both land near the reference median pause).

espeak.note: Calibrated against Reference A: median F0 118.5 Hz (reference 118.5), range ~89-147 Hz (reference 93-144); pauses tuned so speech share and median pause match. Timbre stays synthetic.

music.note: Reference bed: tonal low pad (centroid ~310 Hz, energy 140-340 Hz), no hats or plucks, about 22 dB under the voice.
music.level: un-ducked bed placed measured.bed_minus_speech_db under the narration's speech peaks (audio_profile.bed_gain_db)

master.mode: linear gain + limiter (no dynamic loudnorm, so pauses keep their dynamics)

source: Reference A (FIELDNOTES reel supplied by the owner)
